options.content:
### How to read this dashboard
- **Primary filter** is **$job** (server), sourced from JVM metrics (`jvm_memory_used_bytes{job=~"(minecraft|proxy)/.+"}`) and matching either the bare name or a `minecraft/`/`proxy/` prefix. **$instance** is hidden by default (it's a random UUID that changes on every restart). **$jvm_pool** filters heap/non-heap pools. **$level** filters Loki logs by detected level.
- **Heap used % > 80%** is a warning, **> 90%** risks GC pressure / OOM. Watch **GC pause rate** together with heap: rising GC time alongside heap near the limit is the leading indicator of lag or an upcoming OOM.
- **Logs** come from Loki (uid `loki`), **traces** from Tempo (uid `tempo`), and span-metrics/service-graph data (span rate, error rate, latency, service graph) from Mimir (uid `mimir`) via Tempo's metrics-generator - all filtered to the bare (non-prefixed) `$job` value automatically.
- The recurring error **"An error occurred whilst writing samples to Prometheus" / `UnknownHostException: database01.onelite.feather`** is known baseline noise (a dead Prometheus pushgateway target) that dominates error counts on some servers - it is intentionally not alerted on. See the **Recurring ERROR messages** panel in the Logs row.
- Rows below **Critical (JVM health)** are collapsed by default - expand **Abstract view**, **Detail view**, **Logs** or **Traces** to drill down.

panels.description: JVM CPU utilization (0..1). Sustained high values mean the server is CPU-bound.
panels.title: CPU util (JVM)

panels.description: Thread count. Sudden jumps can indicate leaks or newly activated subsystems.
panels.title: Threads

panels.description: GC time per second. Spikes here often correlate with MSPT spikes.
panels.title: GC pause rate

panels.description: Heap used (sum over heap pools only). See the used-vs-limit panel for headroom.
panels.title: Heap used

panels.description: Heap used as a fraction of the heap limit. 80% is a warning, 90% risks GC pressure / OOM.

targets.expr:
sum by (job) (jvm_memory_used_bytes{jvm_memory_type="heap", job=~"((minecraft|proxy)/)?$job", instance=~"$instance"})
/
sum by (job) (jvm_memory_limit_bytes{jvm_memory_type="heap", job=~"((minecraft|proxy)/)?$job", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Heap used %

panels.description: If used hugs the limit and GC rises, expect lag and potential OOM.
panels.title: Heap used vs limit

panels.description: Non-heap: Metaspace, CodeCache, etc. Leaks here feel 'mysterious' until they crash you.
panels.title: Non-heap used vs limit

panels.description: Higher means the JVM spends more time cleaning up instead of running ticks.
panels.title: GC pause time rate (sec/s)

panels.description: Heap per pool. Use $jvm_pool to isolate pools.
panels.title: Heap pools used (filterable)

panels.description: Non-heap per pool (Metaspace, CodeHeap, etc.).
panels.title: Non-heap pools used (filterable)

panels.description: JVM CPU utilization per server. Sustained values near 1.0 mean the server is CPU-bound.
panels.title: CPU utilization (JVM)

panels.description: Log volume per minute by server and detected level. Sudden spikes in ERROR/WARN are the first sign of trouble.
panels.title: Log lines/min by job and level

panels.description: ERROR + WARN log lines in the last 1h, independent of the dashboard time range.
panels.title: Errors + warnings (last 1h)

panels.description: Distinct ERROR log messages, ranked by count over the dashboard time range. The pushgateway UnknownHostException (see Read me first) is expected to dominate this list - anything else here is a new problem.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (job, body) (count_over_time({exporter="OTLP", job=~"((minecraft|proxy)/)?$job"} | detected_level="ERROR" | json | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Recurring ERROR messages (top 10)

panels.description: Raw logs for $job, filtered to $level.
panels.title: Logs

panels.description: Share of spans reported with STATUS_CODE_ERROR, from Tempo's metrics-generator spanmetrics. Uses the bare (non-prefixed) service name - see Read me first.
panels.title: Span error rate (max series)

panels.description: Span rate by service, from Tempo's metrics-generator spanmetrics. Uses the bare (non-prefixed) service name.
panels.title: Span rate by service

panels.description: Span error rate by service, from Tempo's metrics-generator spanmetrics (status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"). Uses the bare (non-prefixed) service name.
panels.title: Span error ratio by service

panels.description: p95 span latency by service, from Tempo's metrics-generator spanmetrics histogram. Uses the bare (non-prefixed) service name.
panels.title: p95 span latency by service

panels.description: Busiest span names by calls/s, from Tempo's metrics-generator spanmetrics. Filtered to $job (bare service names - see Read me first).
panels.title: Top 10 span names by calls/s

panels.description: Slowest span names by p95 latency, from Tempo's metrics-generator spanmetrics histogram. Filtered to $job (bare service names).

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, span_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service=~"$job"}[5m]))))

panels.title: Top 10 span names by p95 latency

panels.description: Service graph derived from Tempo's metrics-generator service-graph metrics (traces_service_graph_request_total). Uses the bare (non-prefixed) service name - see Read me first.
panels.title: Service graph

panels.description: Traces slower than 500ms for $job (bare name, matches Tempo's service.name directly).
panels.title: Slow traces (>500ms)

panels.description: Trace search for $job (bare name, matches Tempo's service.name directly).
panels.title: Trace search
